supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension beyond the outer corners of the ocular region

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle and perioral region are significantly lighter (pinkish-tan) relative to the darker, mottled pigmentation of the periocular and cheek regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct circular oral configuration due to active vocalization, revealing light-colored mucosal tissue.
